title: Restart Change Order Administration Fee: Calculation — Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — administration fee of a restart change order.**

**1. Restart change order.** A restart change order is a signed change order of a fixed-fee engagement resumed after a client-caused hold longer than the class hold limit that was registered on or after the engagement's resumed date; a change order registered before the resumed date is never a restart change order.

**2. Which change order.** Change orders are numbered in sequence as they are registered, so the restart change order whose fee is figured is the signed change order with the highest change order number, provided it was registered on or after the resumed date. An engagement with no restart change order has no restart change order administration fee.

**3. Fee.** The administration fee of a restart change order is the class change order administration fee; a restart change order is never waived, so it always carries a fee.

**4. Multipliers and rounding.** Any multipliers on the administration fee of a restart change order are multiplied together and applied once to it, and the administration fee is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

| Highest-numbered signed change order | Restart change order? |
|---|---|
| registered on or after the resumed date, engagement held longer than the class hold limit | yes |
| registered before the resumed date | no |
| engagement's hold not longer than the class hold limit | no |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- On a Major Project, whose class administration fee is 350.00, a restart change order carries 350.00, whatever the size of its value change.
- Two multipliers of, hypothetically, 0.5 and 1.1 multiply to 0.55; applied once to 350.00 they give 192.50.
